in_sanskrit.name: विभीषण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is fearful, dreadful or terrible.

in_marathi.name: Vibhishana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vibhishana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vibhishana is a character from the Hindu epic Ramayana, who was the younger brother of Ravana. He was known for his wisdom, bravery, and loyalty.
